environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 behind a basic NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). Environment variable FF_VERBOSE_AUTH_DIAG=true is set in the container environment from a previous debugging session that was never cleaned up. The /api/diagnostics/ endpoint is routable from the public internet. No authentication middleware enforces staff-only access on the diagnostic endpoint. Process runs as a long-lived gunicorn worker with no memory limits enforced by the container runtime.
